observations: The immutable qualification artifact reports planner p95 13.000792000000274ms <=16ms, reducer p95 0.12033400000018446ms <=4ms, passing browser budgets, six passing bundle rows, 100-cycle cleanup, bounded million-row transfer, wide-chart containment, visible-update, heap, standalone, site-route and all-71 document-layout probes.

The retained 17.153ms fresh sample and two passing repeats show run-to-run timing variability and limited headroom. This is a P2 measurement-stability/performance-headroom follow-up, not a hidden success or a current P0/P1 functional blocker.
All qualification limitations remain binding; the evidence describes one Apple M4 Pro/macOS runner and one headless Chromium build.

followUps.summary: Increase planner headroom or reduce timing-runner variability before treating a single isolated run as reliably budget-stable.
